output_json.diff_review: patch_only.diff touches src/main/java/org/codehaus/plexus/util/Expand.java (12 added lines) and adds src/test/java/org/codehaus/plexus/util/ExpandTest.java. The guard is inserted immediately after `File f = FileUtils.resolveFile(dir, entryName);`: it computes `dir.getCanonicalPath() + File.separator` and `f.getCanonicalPath()`, throwing an Exception unless the resolved path equals the dest dir or starts with dest+separator. This runs before every reported sink (FileOutputStream write @178, mkdirs @169, parent mkdirs @165, setLastModified @204), so all four trace endpoints are covered. Trailing-separator prefix matching correctly prevents sibling-prefix bypass (e.g. /dest vs /dest-evil). getCanonicalPath's IOException propagates cleanly since extractFile already declares `throws Exception`. Legitimate nested entries (sub/good.txt) are unaffected. The change is a textbook minimal Zip Slip fix; it does not disable the POV, remove vulnerable functionality, or add unrelated behavior. git confirms only Expand.java is modified and ExpandTest.java added under src/.
issues: Full `mvn -B test` has one failing test, DirectoryScannerTest.testRegexWithSlashInsideCharacterClass, but it is unrelated to and unaffected by this patch (Expand-only change) and is a pre-existing/environment-dependent failure; the security-relevant ExpandTest suite passes.

output_json.summary: The patch adds a canonical-path containment guard in Expand.extractFile() that rejects ZipEntry names resolving outside the destination directory, fixing the CWE-022 Zip Slip. The fix is minimal and isolated (Expand.java only, plus a new ExpandTest), does not alter the POV or remove functionality, the POV no longer reproduces (exits 1, NOT VULNERABLE), and the targeted ExpandTest regression passes. The only full-suite failure (DirectoryScannerTest regex test) is unrelated to and unaffected by this change.
